BiblicalUsage: Jigdaljah is Igdaliah, a man whose son Hanan had a chamber in the house of the LORD. In Jeremiah 35:4, the son of Igdaliah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Igdaliah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
